name: wildanfrananda/kinetix-contracts
description: Kinetix wire contracts — generated from kinetix-contracts. Do not edit.

require._comment_protobuf: Lower bound, not a caret. The generated classes use the runtime API that has been stable across 4.x and 5.x, and a caret excluded 5.x outright — which made the package uninstallable in kinetix-review-service, whose Laravel 13 tree already required google/protobuf ^5.36. A contracts package that cannot be installed beside a current framework is not a shared contract.
